Question: How many days are there from 2021-07-18 to 2021-10-19 (count the end date but not the start date)?
Answer: 93 days.
Calculation: July 19-31 = 13 days (excluding start date Jul 18), August = 31, September = 30, October 1-19 = 19 days. Total = 13+31+30+19 = 93.
